objective: Win paid freelance scientific-editing assignments by matching documented research experience to an official specialist vacancy and showing reproducible LaTeX revision proof without claiming client editing credits.

source_need.title: Current Freelancer Vacancies
source_need.eligibility: Remote freelance pool; the official page names physics, computer science, artificial intelligence, algorithms, mechanics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and related subjects
source_need.published_process: Email the applications address with an introductory email or brief CV; shortlisted applicants are tested
source_need.policy: The official careers page is a current application route. It does not publish assignment volume, rates, test terms, or a work guarantee; an application is not a lead or revenue.

supported_now: Doctoral research in imaging systems plus MSc and BSc training
Documented publication work spanning imaging, machine learning, Bayesian analysis, and chemistry
A public three-build LaTeX revision and redline sample with issue ledger
LaTeX, BibTeX, build, reference, figure, table, and source-change workflows
not_proven: Acceptance into the Lex Academic freelancer pool
Compliance with an unseen house style or editorial test
Any assignment volume, rate, turnaround, or client outcome
fit.claim_boundary: The CV source and public artifacts support research experience and a project-owned manuscript workflow. They do not prove a client editing history, acceptance, an assignment, or revenue.

application.method: One concise email to the applications address on the official careers page
application.delivery_evidence: The exact recipient token, LazyingArt sender alias, subject, body, one-attachment indicator, and enabled Send control passed a visible-browser validation immediately before one send click. The composer closed, and the Sent mailbox then showed the exact recipient, full subject, body, attachment preview, and 11:59 AM delivery minute.

automated_acknowledgement.published_wait: If the applicant does not hear back within 10 days, the application should be treated as unsuccessful
automated_acknowledgement.policy: The message is an automatic application acknowledgement. It is not shortlisting, a test invitation, a lead, an assignment, payment, or revenue.

application.policy: Verify the recipient, subject, final attachment, and visible sent evidence exactly once. Any editorial test, house style, manuscript, NDA, assignment, rate, deadline, contract, or payment must be reviewed on its own terms.
